model_choices_not_verified.wall_and_opening_layout: Omitted from the authoritative frame model; envelope visualization only if shown.
model_choices_not_verified.eave_overhang_datum: Total horizontal distance perpendicular to each wall, measured beyond the outside envelope of assumed radial 8x8 posts; exterior cladding thickness not specified.
model_choices_not_verified.perimeter_post_head_joinery: Post body ends at ring underside; post head tenon/housing not modeled or dimensioned.

temporary_works.black_central_assembly: Temporary for initial construction; later removed, explicitly confirmed by Stewart Lundy.
temporary_works.grey_vertical_shore: Shown as supporting the black assembly in the supplied erection image; treated as a temporary support in the construction-stage diagram, subject to confirmation.
temporary_works.removal_sequence: Not determined. No removal timing or structural release instruction is provided.

user_design_changes.overhang_interpretation: 2 ft 6 in total, not 2 ft 6 in additional to previous 18 inches
user_design_changes.corner_cleanup: All eight eave-ring and all 24 cupola-band members use matching vertical radial miter planes; ideal geometry only, no connection capacity or final timber joinery asserted.
user_design_changes.post_corner_cleanup: Correct body top from eave-ring top to eave-ring underside, removing exposed brown post caps above the hip surface. XY locations and sections unchanged. Final post-head joinery unresolved.

main_roof_overhang_datum: Total horizontal distance perpendicular to each wall, measured beyond the outside envelope of assumed radial 8x8 posts; exterior cladding thickness not specified.
status: FITTED GEOMETRIC PROTOTYPE - independently audited; structural capacity and fabrication allowances unverified
axis_convention: GLB coordinates: X horizontal, Y up, Z horizontal. Original plan Y equals -GLB Z. Model axes are not surveyed site north.
angle_convention: Axis inclination is the acute angle above the horizontal plane. Azimuth is from model +X toward original plan +Y. Off-square cut uses 0 deg for a square crosscut.
notes: All 104 permanent members from the current frame model are included individually. Ten temporary pieces are included in their own default-hidden group.
Roof envelope facets, furniture, bookshelves, floor assembly and other unmodeled components are not invented as cuttable pieces.
Every actual fabrication joint is unresolved. Mesh end-plane angles are geometric display data, not verified cutting instructions.
22.5 deg plan miter is an equal-octagon geometric relationship. Source structural joint type, housings and connections remain unverified.

notes: Actual complementary recess/projection geometry replaces overlapping display solids.
Zero nominal mating clearance in the mathematical model; digital checks have stated tolerances.
Dimensions retained from source are nominal axis/section references, not a new verified cutting list.
Central keyed features use 40% of nominal member width/depth as an explicit visualization/design assumption, not structural sizing guidance.
8 x 8 in posts and eave height are unverified model choices. Post bodies end at the eave-ring underside (7 ft 2 in) as the revised display bearing datum; post-head tenons and housings are unresolved.
Modeled solid end faces are square to the axis (0 deg off square / 90 deg to axis); fabricated ends are unresolved.
Model length is the center-to-center prism length. No tenon allowance, kerf, stock allowance or joint trimming is included.
Source-model bearing datum: underside of eave ring; post-head tenons/housings not modeled. Post body height excludes any unmodeled head tenon or other joint allowance.
